description: Plain technical sentences scored on the raw ASR transcript (no polish). requiredTokens are ASR-stable content words only; casing is not asserted. Establishes the recognition floor the polish strata build on.

cases.spokenForm: the integration tests fail on main since yesterday. the websocket client times out after ten seconds. look at the reconnect logic and add a regression test before changing anything else.
cases.intendedText: The integration tests fail on main since yesterday. The websocket client times out after ten seconds. Look at the reconnect logic and add a regression test before changing anything else.
cases.notes: Multi-sentence Claude Code prompt shape: context + symptom + request + constraint.

cases.spokenForm: the view model file is getting too large. split the session lifecycle into its own file but keep the public interface unchanged.
cases.intendedText: The view model file is getting too large. Split the session lifecycle into its own file but keep the public interface unchanged.
cases.notes: Refactor request with a hard constraint; all tokens are dictionary words.

cases.spokenForm: profile the app for memory leaks during long dictation sessions and summarize what allocations grow over time.
cases.intendedText: Profile the app for memory leaks during long dictation sessions and summarize what allocations grow over time.
cases.notes: Investigation ask with domain nouns the ASR must not mangle.

cases.spokenForm: explain how the overlap merge algorithm decides which words from the previous transcript survive into the merged result.
cases.intendedText: Explain how the overlap merge algorithm decides which words from the previous transcript survive into the merged result.
cases.notes: Question about this repo's own text-merge subsystem.

cases.spokenForm: the continuous integration job was flaky twice this week. find the flaky test, explain the race, and propose a deterministic fix.
cases.intendedText: The continuous integration job was flaky twice this week. Find the flaky test, explain the race, and propose a deterministic fix.
cases.notes: CI-debugging vocabulary; 'flaky' and 'deterministic' are common ASR casualties.

cases.spokenForm: review the last three commits for concurrency issues and tell me if any shared state is mutated without a lock.
cases.intendedText: Review the last three commits for concurrency issues and tell me if any shared state is mutated without a lock.

cases.spokenForm: when the backend crashes on startup we lose the error message. capture standard error and surface the last line in the alert.
cases.intendedText: When the backend crashes on startup we lose the error message. Capture standard error and surface the last line in the alert.
cases.notes: Bug report + fix request across two sentences.

cases.spokenForm: measure the latency between the microphone chunk arriving and the text appearing, then break it down by pipeline stage.
cases.intendedText: Measure the latency between the microphone chunk arriving and the text appearing, then break it down by pipeline stage.

cases.spokenForm: update the readme section about installation and mention that the first launch downloads the model weights.
cases.intendedText: Update the readme section about installation and mention that the first launch downloads the model weights.
cases.notes: Docs ask; 'readme' itself is excluded from tokens because ASR may split it.

cases.spokenForm: what does the health monitor do when the audio device disappears in the middle of a session
cases.intendedText: What does the health monitor do when the audio device disappears in the middle of a session?
cases.notes: Bare question with no dictated punctuation at all.

cases.spokenForm: add retry logic to the download step. do not touch the settings code. keep the diff small and add a unit test.
cases.intendedText: Add retry logic to the download step. Do not touch the settings code. Keep the diff small and add a unit test.
cases.notes: Terse imperative style with negative constraints — common agent-prompt shape.

cases.spokenForm: steps to reproduce. start dictation, switch to another window, stop dictation. the overlay stays on screen forever.
cases.intendedText: Steps to reproduce. Start dictation, switch to another window, stop dictation. The overlay stays on screen forever.

cases.spokenForm: les tests d'intégration échouent depuis hier matin. regarde la logique de reconnexion et ajoute un test de régression.
cases.intendedText: Les tests d'intégration échouent depuis hier matin. Regarde la logique de reconnexion et ajoute un test de régression.
cases.notes: French mirror of the multi-sentence prompt shape; accented tokens stress ASR.

cases.spokenForm: profile l'application pour trouver la fuite mémoire pendant les longues sessions de dictée.
cases.intendedText: Profile l'application pour trouver la fuite mémoire pendant les longues sessions de dictée.
cases.notes: French investigation ask with accented domain nouns.

cases.spokenForm: explique comment l'algorithme de fusion décide quels mots de la transcription précédente survivent.
cases.intendedText: Explique comment l'algorithme de fusion décide quels mots de la transcription précédente survivent.
cases.notes: French question about the merge algorithm.

cases.spokenForm: relis les trois derniers commits et dis-moi si un état partagé est modifié sans verrou.
cases.intendedText: Relis les trois derniers commits et dis-moi si un état partagé est modifié sans verrou.
cases.notes: French review ask mixing an English loanword (commits) with French jargon.

cases.spokenForm: mesure la latence entre l'arrivée du son du micro et l'affichage du texte à l'écran.
cases.intendedText: Mesure la latence entre l'arrivée du son du micro et l'affichage du texte à l'écran.

cases.spokenForm: ajoute une logique de nouvelle tentative au téléchargement. ne touche pas au code des réglages.
cases.intendedText: Ajoute une logique de nouvelle tentative au téléchargement. Ne touche pas au code des réglages.
cases.notes: French imperative with a negative constraint.

cases.spokenForm: que fait le moniteur de santé audio quand le périphérique disparaît au milieu d'une session
cases.intendedText: Que fait le moniteur de santé audio quand le périphérique disparaît au milieu d'une session ?
cases.notes: French bare question, no dictated punctuation.
